notes:
Fix: some versions (21.51, 22.00…) stayed on a black screen then crashed at launch ("Ran out of memory allocating 205235675136 bytes").

- Cause: Epic leftover files next to the game (`Cloud` folder, `.egstore`…) made the game try to download content from Epic's servers and crash.
- Before every launch, the launcher now renames everything in the build folder that is not `FortniteGame` or `Engine` (adds `.vibin-off`, nothing is deleted). No need to reinstall the version anymore.

Also in 1.3.1: friends & groups in game and in the launcher are now the same thing (invite, accept, request to join, leave, kick).
